title: Righteousness by Faith
blurb: A judge calls a guilty man righteous. Is it a cover-up? No: God's word is a seed, and it brings faith, forgiveness and power.

Cast sheets: how each cast member is drawn and kept (ask ae44af894e1): four: Four cast members on one shared sheet, kept in one ask · drift: The kept concept, as your rounds changed it. The view is drawn again until it matches. A view a tuned rig already holds is never painted again. · standard: All six views, the house poses and the head tilts, drawn once · sleeve: A sleeve may hang at rest, but never reach toward a hand · store: The kept images committed beside the member (about 6 MB each); the tries stay in the lab's out/ · keep: Pick a try per kind, then decide only the views the measure flagged (three taps for a clean sheet) · else: Jesus's render confuses parts of his hair with his beard, look more closely to the concept

The flow gains a cast stage on each side of the Board: the concept draws every cast member as a sheet (angles and poses); after the storyboard, each member's rig is rendered to its sheet and kept; only then are scenes rendered.
said.quote: heres the workflow im thinking - concept draws cast in various angles, poses, etc, then storyboard, then we render each cast according to the character sheet, then we can be confident of rendering scenes
